constraint: Rebuild only the complete wall-rack region and its immediate wall footprint in rejected Swords-9 attempt-001; whole-canvas resampling is allowed. Preserve exactly one wakeful fully clothed adult, face, hair, both natural hands covering only the lower face, visible eyes and breathing space, seated anatomy, bed, pillow, rumpled blanket, window, first light, room, crop, palette and rendering. Keep every sword beside the bed and never above it or near the body. Remove the entire existing five-sword rack, all five swords, rails, slots and shadows, then reconstruct matching bare wall with no ghost. Build exactly one plain rectangular dark-wood rack wholly on the viewer-right side wall, large enough to remain countable at 140 by 196. Divide it into exactly nine equal separated recessed bays in a strict three-column by three-row grid. Put exactly one complete horizontal closed steel scabbard in each bay, for exactly three swords in the top row, three in the middle row and three in the bottom row. Preserve the ordinary worried wakefulness without diagnosis or horror. Add no second person, animal, monster, ghost, wound, blood, self-harm action, exposed blade, extra rack, text or mark.
